# H6 sheet-choice regression

`manufacturing_pmi.step.gz` is a deterministic gzip copy of the maintainer's editor
smoke part `stage-h` scratch `plate/manufacturing-pmi.step` (Specify GD&T and
manufacturing PMI), supplied for H6 on 2026-10-12. No model geometry or PMI was edited.

Uncompressed SHA-256: 664cd3d720dc4f91dc00e0a9991e6f550e56499f47f9d3c25fde77b34ae1f5be

The regression checks A3/A4 at 1:1 or larger, six drawn GD&T items, no label ink
collision, and every view clear of the title block. Unsupported surface texture and
attribute-set extraction findings remain visible; they are outside sheet selection.
